Is need\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIf it is just due to compression of cold ab\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EMy analysis\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;The \u0026nbsp;spine wis secondarily affected in the TB.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EProper examination for the local deficits of the involved region ... Is need\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIf it is just due to compression of cold abscess will the draining of abscess helps him to continue his normal life\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ERenal\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Ehttps:\/\/61tejarshini.blogspot.com\/2021\/06\/general-medicine-case-discussion.html?m=1\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOverview\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; A 45 yr old male with cheif complaints of : Altered Sensorium (Hypo active) and lethargy since \u0026nbsp;Morning\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHistory of fever 10 days back,lasted for 3 days, followed by Pedal edema with Anasarca with Shortness of breath present even at rest .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAppraisal\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Emonitoring of \u0026nbsp;creatinine and halting the damage to kidney without going to irreversible failure was commendable\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAlso dialysis helped the patient's encephalopathy\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAll the problems like infection, hypertension and chronic proteinuria causing kidney failure were addressed well and treated\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENegative points\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;addiction history \u0026nbsp;was incomplete which might help diagnosis and liver cirrhosis\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient was not warned or given medication for hypertension or pedal edema which might be first sign of renal failure\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe liver failure was not explained which had lead to cirrhosis\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EMy analysis\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI think case history was \u0026nbsp;incompletel\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Eproper management of initial \u0026nbsp;symptoms like pedal edema or hypertension \u0026nbsp;would have been better\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECVS\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Ehttps:\/\/60shirisha.blogspot.com\/2021\/06\/medicine-case-discussion_14.html?m=1\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOverview\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;A 70 year old female presented to casuality with complaints of Distension of abdomen and shortness of breath Grade-3 since 5days\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;Appraisal\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; Diagnosis and tests were adequate. The problem in the heart was localised with 2D echo. The wall abnormality and the chamber affected were seen.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENegative points\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Ethe cause for abdominal distention was not addressed properly\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;the cause for atrial fibrillation in a hypothyroidism patient was not solved.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EMy analysis\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe diagnosis must also should have taken the age of the patient into consideration as she is of 70yrs of age were any interventions are not successful and the problem lies in the degeneration of tissue due to old age.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECaptured by one student from 2019 batch in the link below :\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAbdominal\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Ehttps:\/\/casescape.blogspot.com\/2021\/06\/acute-kidney-injury-secondary-to.html?m=1\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOverview:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EA 60yr old female presented to the OPD with chief complaints of pedal edema since 10 days, decreased urine output since 10 days and fever since 10 days.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAppraisal\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECase was take in detailed format\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EEvery day follow up was very well done\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EExamination and investigations were done as needed\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENegative points\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;There are no pus cells or markers of inflammation in the due report.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhy she has bp of 170\/90\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Einfection signs in CUE\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EMy analysis\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;I think it could be diagnosed as \u0026nbsp;urinary tract infection with diabetes mellitus which is leading to acute kidney injury.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EQ5)Testing scholarship competency in \u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Elogging reflective observations on your concrete experiences of this last month : (10 marks)\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EReflective logging of one's own experiences is a vital tool toward competency development in medical education and research.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHere are the pictures of the log notes I've done during the postings for better understanding the patient symptoms and to reach a correct diagnosis.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/photos.app.goo.gl\/5diD2gepcjsKrcEh6\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/photos.app.goo.gl\/5diD2gepcjsKrcEh6\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E"},"link":[{"rel":"replies","type":"application/atom+xml","href":"https:\/\/goudigamapreethi3036.blogspot.com\/feeds\/7476693485496574953\/comments\/default","title":"Post Comments"},{"rel":"replies","type":"text/html","href":"https:\/\/goudigamapreethi3036.blogspot.com\/2021\/07\/june-assessment.html#comment-form","title":"0 Comments"},{"rel":"edit","type":"application/atom+xml","href":"https:\/\/www.blogger.com\/feeds\/8366802356382627848\/posts\/default\/7476693485496574953"},{"rel":"self","type":"application/atom+xml","href":"https:\/\/www.blogger.com\/feeds\/8366802356382627848\/posts\/default\/7476693485496574953"},{"rel":"alternate","type":"text/html","href":"https:\/\/goudigamapreethi3036.blogspot.com\/2021\/07\/june-assessment.html","title":"June assessment "}],"author":[{"name":{"$t":"G.
